evidence: Actual matching UseItem UID/grid success plus complete fresh inventory decrease or exact HP increase is required within the original 2000ms monotonic receipt boundary.
Consumption and healing are separate flags; no consumed dose is falsely claimed to have already raised HP.

Single independent HP promise, same per-account three-command send budget and 6000ms performance.now reuse stamp shared across same-process resume; no native opportunity is completed or paused by maintenance.
Owner identity/map/death, rejection, missing or late proof, and send failures remain fail-closed.
No purchase, grant, MP, revival, server rule or production behavior changed.
A new segment is prepared only for a valid same-target/map nonzero Walk/Run after the prior attackSent state.
Only actual successful send commits the segment; plan selection, pending work, budget rejection, navigation rejection and synchronous send failure do not reset it.
Original fresh successful nonzero UserLocation progress remains the only movement accounting input; original 40 movements, 30000ms, three visits and nonprogress rules are retained.
The segment is not repeatedly rebuilt during subsequent replans; resume accounting code is unchanged.
Only active living same-map declared observers whose actual snapshot contains both attacker and valid target may qualify.
The actual observer owner must be within six Chebyshev cells of both attacker and target; minimum maximum-separation wins with stable original peer order for ties.
Immediately before send the target, observer, receiver attacker ID and observer sequence are re-resolved.
No eligible witness leaves an evidence-wait native opportunity incomplete; attacks/hits are not fabricated and the opportunity denominator remains.
Original full AOI sixteen-cell coverage, V2 results, original dual-end positive damage/health proof, 900ms deadline and ambiguous-target quarantine remain.

limitations: Static source and fixture review does not prove a new live gameplay load or capacity pass.
The original08/09 failures remain failures; no historical attack result is reclassified.
Six-cell witness geometry reduces boundary exposure but cannot guarantee delivery or keep a moving target inside AOI for the whole damage window.
The monotonic reuse stamp is shared across resume within this driver process, not a persistent across-process clock.
